issueDispositions.location: Full PDF page7; infection block5; overview table full/sample page3 and summary page1
issueDispositions.disposition: Added the acute Table2 primary result and identified the CID endpoint as the separate follow-up primary. Overview wording also names the long-term report.

CID Table3 supports 2.9% versus3.6%; CID Table2 supports593/2983 missing, including300 and293 byarm. Replaced vague missingness with exact counts andtable references; these figures are not from the JAMA report.

Replaced pooled49/111 with32/71(45.1%) at750mg twice daily and17/40(42.5%) at500mg twice daily; placebo49/138(35.5%). Explicit sequential enrollment, no randomized dose comparison. Retracted original stays excluded.
Added eGFR30–60 contrast stopping rule, other labeled contrast criteria,48h eGFR reassessment and restart only ifstable. Added age65+, acute hypoxic heart failure andsepsis context.

issueDispositions.disposition: 31 references with authors/corporate authors, journal/publisher and year/date status. All27 scholarly entries have verifiedDOIs. Four official label/FDA documents explicitly lack assignedDOIs. No fixed reference quota.
